object_description: Three compact volumes linked by a central multipurpose hall
design_condition: The compact one-storey building is placed along the eastern edge, generating a well-sized schoolyard whose cuts establish neighborhood-scaled exterior zones, although the elongated extensions require fencing.

positive.statement: The compact building generates a schoolyard of beautiful size.

position.rationale: The broad western open area is visibly generated beside the compact eastern building.

positive.statement: The cuts in the form give the outdoor spaces adequate proportions at neighborhood scale.

position.rationale: Cuts in the footprint visibly divide the western and southern exterior zones.

positive.statement: The building logically organizes three accesses as exterior extensions of the hall space.

position.target: three accesses as exterior extensions of the hall
position.rationale: The central hall is identifiable, while individual access points are only approximately localized.

positive.statement: The distribution of the different groups of premises is coherent.

position.target: distribution of different groups of premises
position.rationale: The articulated footprint and central hall provide a useful building-wide organization anchor.

positive.statement: The jury appreciated the architectural design, layout and general organization.

position.target: architectural design, layout and general organization
position.rationale: Overall judgment is anchored to the compact articulated building mass.

positive.statement: The supporting system provides good gravity-load descent and adequate seismic behavior.

position.rationale: The structural system is not individually visible; the eastern building mass provides a constrained anchor.

positive.statement: The project meets fire quality assurance requirements.

position.rationale: Fire compliance has no distinct exterior point-cloud marker.

negative.statement: The exterior extensions suffer from elongated proportions and require fences with a significant impact on the site.

position.rationale: Long projecting edges visibly shape the western and southern exterior areas.

negative.statement: The organizational plan loses clarity in the southern part where staff rooms extend the L-shaped plan.

position.rationale: The southern extension is visibly represented along the lower edge of the plan.

negative.statement: The central gap is difficult to perceive and the jury has difficulty recognizing the theme of the world of childhood.

position.rationale: The central gap is visibly small and enclosed within the surrounding mass.

negative.statement: The central patio appears poorly sized, despite being necessary as a source of light.

position.rationale: A small central opening is clearly visible within the compact building footprint.

negative.statement: The future expansion raises questions about the central location and reduced dimension of vertical circulation.

position.rationale: Vertical circulation is not distinguishable; the central hall is the constrained likely location.

negative.statement: The project fails to convince with its identity inside and outside.

position.rationale: The criticism concerns the overall compact envelope and its exterior expression.

negative.statement: The heavy reinforced-concrete roof slab may require deep foundations on the poor-bearing-capacity soils.

position.rationale: Roof material is not identifiable, so the eastern roof surface is used as an approximate anchor.

negative.statement: A lightweight wooden roof would have better complemented the earthen walls and biosourced materials.

position.rationale: The proposed roof material is absent visually; a western roof surface supplies a constrained location.

negative.statement: The project gives no indication of the planned extension.

position.rationale: No extension is visible; the eastern perimeter is a plausible future-growth location.
